tools.name: officegest_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with tax id, contacts and status. Filter by name, tax id, email, active flag or type. Pass meta.next as cursor for the next page. Uses GET /entities/customers.

tools.name: officegest_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: name, tax id, address, contacts, type and status. Uses GET /entities/customers/{customer}.

tools.name: officegest_get_customer_balance
tools.description: Get the current balance of one customer: what the customer owes the company. Uses GET /entities/customers/{customer}/balance.

tools.name: officegest_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Creates data in OfficeGest; it does not merge with an existing customer, so search first. Uses POST /entities/customers.

tools.name: officegest_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with tax id, contacts and status. Filter by search text, name, tax id, e-mail or active flag. Uses GET /entities/suppliers.

tools.name: officegest_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id: name, tax id, address and contacts. Uses GET /entities/suppliers/{supplier}.

tools.name: officegest_search_articles
tools.description: Search articles (products and services) by text, barcode, family or warehouse. Uses GET /stocks/articles/search.

tools.name: officegest_get_article
tools.description: Get one article by id: description, prices, measurement unit, VAT and stock totals. Uses GET /stocks/articles/{article}.

tools.name: officegest_list_stock_quantities
tools.description: List stock quantities per article and warehouse. Zero-stock rows are left out unless include_zero_stock is true. Uses GET /stocks/quantities.

tools.name: officegest_list_sale_document_types
tools.description: List the sale document types of the company, with their codes. Use a code with officegest_list_sale_documents. Uses GET /sales/documents.

tools.name: officegest_list_sale_documents
tools.description: List sale documents of one type (for example invoices), with number, customer, date, due date and state. Pass meta.next as cursor for the next page. Uses GET /sales/documents/{type}.

tools.name: officegest_get_sale_document
tools.description: Get one sale document by type and id: header, customer, lines and totals. Uses GET /sales/documents/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: officegest_get_sales_summary
tools.description: Get the sales summary: the current month, the previous month, the monthly average and the current year. Uses GET /sales/reports/sales-summary.

tools.name: officegest_list_customer_invoices_due
tools.description: List customer invoices that are not yet fully paid, with the amount pending. Uses GET /sales/reports/customer-invoices-due.

tools.name: officegest_list_top_debtors
tools.description: List the customers who owe the most, with their balance. Uses GET /sales/reports/top-debtors.

tools.name: officegest_list_supplier_invoices_due
tools.description: List supplier invoices that are not yet fully settled, with the amount pending. Uses GET /purchases/reports/supplier-invoices-due.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: officegest_list_customers, officegest_create_customer · Private data: officegest_list_customers, officegest_get_customer, officegest_create_customer, officegest_list_suppliers, officegest_get_supplier, officegest_list_sale_document_types, officegest_list_sale_documents, officegest_get_sale_document · Public sink: officegest_list_customers, officegest_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: officegest_list_customers, officegest_create_customer · Private data: officegest_list_customers, officegest_get_customer, officegest_create_customer, officegest_list_suppliers, officegest_get_supplier, officegest_list_sale_document_types, officegest_list_sale_documents, officegest_get_sale_document · Public sink: officegest_list_customers, officegest_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
